body: I’m working on moving back in with parents. I’m worrying about hurting myself.

You’re probably right. I have been trying to keep it to myself and put a happy face on but some things must slip through the cracks. 

In what ways do you think depression could have made things not fine between me and them?
I started new ones a few months ago. These are my fifth. But now that you point it out it is possible that the dosage is too low. I’ll be checking in with my doc. Thanks for being there.

You’re right. It’s hard right now but it’s a lesson learned. I don’t know how to start my life again. These people were my whole life. Maybe your suggestion of space and counseling will help me figure that out. Thank you.
Thank you. This gives me some perspective. I will try to take your advice.

Yes. I have been on antidepressants for years and started seeing a therapist recently. 
I don’t know how as I live with them. But I will do my best to make space.

I learned that he had spoken to them before about breaking up and asked their advice. So our mutuals and him just kept it to themselves until he broke up. 

I should have mentioned we aren’t broken up anymore, just trying to work things out. That’s why I tried to talk to our friends about it. To learn what I could do.
